Rina (Design): quick sync: debating inline-only errors vs inline + compact top summary for the new compact dashboard forms. thoughts? Tom (PM): we need a clear default. data shows users often skip to CTA and miss inline hints. Soo (Eng): inline is simple to implement. summary adds focus/rotation complexity but doable. main perf concern is layout jump when summary appears. Eve (A11y): accessibility-first: if there's a top summary, it must be reachable by keyboard and announced by screen readers. prefer summary focus on submit failure. Noor (Frontend): pattern we used before: collapsed one-line summary that expands when focused or when user clicks "View details". keeps layout tight. Rina (Design): layout idea: one-line pill with text "Fix 3 issues" and chevron. expands to small list of field links. compact but scannable. Ben (Design Ops): copy question: header = "Fix 3 issues" vs "We couldn't save". which is clearer for users skimming? Tom (PM): "Fix 3 issues" is more actionable and shorter. good for tight UIs. Eve (A11y): microcopy note: make sure each item link includes context, e.g., "Name — required" so screen reader users get meaning. also include role="region" and aria-labelledby. Soo (Eng): implementation sketch from Noor looks fine. we'll reserve space for expanded list to avoid reflow. can animate via transform. Noor (Frontend): code sketch we can reuse: ```
  • Name — required
  • Email — invalid
``` Soo (Eng): when submit fails, JS should remove `data-collapsed` and call `.focus()` on `.summary` element. set `aria-expanded` on toggle. Eve (A11y): also set focus trap rules? if user presses Esc, close list and move focus to first invalid field. and use `aria-live="polite"` for non-critical notifications. Rina (Design): destructive flow: standardize modal copy. propose: Title: "Delete dataset" Body: "This will permanently remove dataset X and associated artifacts." Primary: "Delete dataset" Secondary: "Cancel". typed-confirm only for high-risk items. Ben (Design Ops): propose risk thresholds in design kit: risk >= 8 -> typed-confirm; 5-7 -> checkbox + bold action; <=4 -> confirmation only. Tom (PM): we'll want telemetry: how often people expand summary, click links, or abandon. add events: validation_summary_shown, validation_link_clicked. Noor (Frontend): will add data attributes for analytics hooks. Soo (Eng): edge-case: mobile small screens. collapsed summary should be full-width pill and expansion pushes content; that's fine. ensure announcements still fire. Eve (A11y): mobile talkback/voiceover note: after submit failure, announce "Form submission failed. 3 errors. First error: Name required." then focus follows link. Rina (Design): quick poll: collapsed summary by default for compact forms? react with :thumbsup: yes, :thumbsdown: no. Noor (Frontend): :thumbsup: Soo (Eng): :thumbsup: Eve (A11y): :thumbsup: Ben (Design Ops): :thumbsdown (prefer always visible for safety-critical flows) Tom (PM): decision: collapsed-by-default for compact, but require opt-in expanded for safety-critical pages. action items: Rina/Ben update kit with copy + risk rules; Noor/Soo prototype component with aria behavior; Eve to draft a11y checklist for validation UX; Tom to create telemetry ticket. Rina (Design): I'll push mocks and copy options by tomorrow afternoon. thanks all. (automated) designbot: created ticket D-4312 "Compact form validation: collapsed summary + risk-gated typed-confirm" assigned to Rina, due sprint-end.
